hadith:
(Statements made under) Coercion - Narrated Abu Huraira:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(The Prophet) Abraham migrated with his wife Sarah till he reached a town where there was a king or a tyrant who sent a message, to Abraham, ordering him to send Sarah to him. So when Abraham had sent Sarah, the tyrant got up, intending to do evil with her, but she got up and performed ablution and prayed and said, 'O Allah ! If I have believed in You and in Your Apostle, then do not empower this oppressor over me.' So he (the king) had an epileptic fit and started moving his legs violently. "
message: When facing oppression or hardship, remember that Allah is As-Saboor—The Patient One—who endures all things with perfect compassion and mercy, and He encourages us to embody that same patience in our trials. Just as Prophet Abraham's wife Sarah turned to Allah in her moment of distress with complete trust, we too should seek refuge in sincere prayer and unwavering faith, knowing that Allah's revelations are truth and He will never abandon those who believe in Him.
name:
As Saboor - الصَّبُورُ - The Patient One

The name As Saboor signifies Allah's enduring patience and ability to withhold anger and punishment, emphasizing His compassion and mercy towards humanity. The concept encourages believers to embody patience in their own lives, understanding the importance of forbearance in facing life's challenges.
verse:
Al-Baqarah - The Cow - 2:252

These are Allah’s revelations which We recite to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth. And you are truly one of the messengers.
